title: #smallpoems response touch of sound tossed abound into vacuums of space softening tenors hiding a blazed fate seeking to knock, knock on Nebula's gate
summary: #smallpoems response touch of sound tossed abound into vacuums of space softening tenors hiding a blazed fate seeking to knock, knock on Nebula's gate Our eternal seed unlocking the graveyard of the sun or nurseries collapsing in on life?
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems response
touch of sound
tossed abound into
vacuums of space
softening tenors
hiding a blazed fate
seeking to knock,
knock on Nebula's gate
Our eternal seed
unlocking the graveyard of the sun
or nurseries collapsing
in on life?
